title: Alibaba unveils Quark AI Glasses at WAIC 2025, release in China by end-2025
detail: Alibaba Cloud press release at WAIC 2025 (Shanghai): Quark AI Glasses unveiled, 'scheduled for official release in China by the end of 2025', powered by Qwen, with 'long battery life and high-quality imaging'.

title: Quark AI Glasses launched in China: S1 from 3,799 yuan, G1 from 1,899 yuan
detail: Xinhua: Quark AI Glasses launched in China in two series and six SKUs; S1 from 3,799 yuan (dual micro-OLED display), G1 from 1,899 yuan (no display, 40 g).

title: Quark S1/G1 spec sheet: Qualcomm AR1 + BES2800, 12 MP camera, 3K video
detail: GIGAZINE spec sheet: S1 dual-chip with replaceable dual batteries (up to 24 h) and bone-conduction voice; G1 shares the S1 core minus display. Baidu Baike for G1: Qualcomm AR1 + BES2800, 272 mAh, 9 h, 5 mics, '12-megapixel camera capable of 3K video'.

title: Alibaba Cloud: Qwen Glasses S1/G1, G1 from RMB 1,997, China sales 2026-03-08, international within 2026
detail: Alibaba Cloud blog: Qwen Glasses S1 (premium) and G1 series (incl. sunglasses in 7 lens colours); G1 from RMB 1,997 (~$275); official China sales 2026-03-08; 'international release within 2026'.

title: MWC Barcelona 2026 (Mar 2–5): Alibaba Qwen AI Glasses reservations opened day 1
detail: MWC Barcelona 2026 (2026-03-02 to 03-05); Alibaba opened Qwen AI Glasses reservations on day 1.

title: Qwen Glasses MWC specs: 12 MP Sony IMX681, 5P lens, 109° FOV, Snapdragon AR1
detail: The Deep View booth specs: 12 MP POV camera with Sony IMX681 sensor, 5P lens, 109° ultra-wide, 3K video, HDR; Snapdragon AR1 + coprocessor; swappable 272 mAh packs; 8 mm temples. No autofocus mentioned.

title: AWE2026 (Appliance & Electronics World Expo), Shanghai, Mar 12–15: full Qwen Glasses lineup shown
detail: Qwen Glasses full lineup shown at AWE2026 = Appliance & Electronics World Expo, Shanghai SNIEC, 2026-03-12 to 03-15 (not Augmented World Expo).

title: Alizila: Qwen Glasses 'spatial 3D display' upgrade; claims 53% of China online smart-glasses sales
detail: Alizila: Qwen Glasses upgrade with 'proactive AI' services and a 'spatial 3D display' using 'dual optical engines with binocular stereoscopic imaging'; company claims 53% share of China online smart-glasses sales cumulative since launch.

title: Qwen previews 'N1' glasses at Bund Summit: no display, iris recognition
detail: TechNode (via IT Home): Qwen previewed 'N1' glasses at the 2026 Bund Summit in Shanghai with no display and iris recognition; specs, price and date not disclosed.

title: Alizila confirms Qwen N1 series (50 MP), pre-orders 2026-09-22, sales 2026-10-13, China only
detail: Alibaba's Alizila: Qwen Glasses N1 series with 50 MP camera; N1 Pro with eye-tracking and iris payment; pre-orders from 2026-09-22, sales 2026-10-13; China only. Also Qwen Clip earbuds with Bose.
